import html # Predefined HTML template for a user post. # Placeholders: {user_name}, {post_heading}, {post_content}, {post_tags} USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{post_heading}

by {user_name}

{post_content}
{post_tags}
""" def build_post_html(user_name: str, post_heading: str, post_content: str, post_tags: list[str]) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML representation of a user's post. Parameters ---------- user_name : str The author of the post. post_heading : str Title of the user's post. post_content : str Main content of the user's post. post_tags : list[str] List of tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized HTML representation of the user's post. """ # Escape user-controllable input to prevent XSS (CWE-79) safe_user_name = html.escape(user_name, quote=True) safe_heading = html.escape(post_heading, quote=True) safe_content = html.escape(post_content, quote=False) # Preserve line breaks # Build tags: each tag is wrapped in a element safe_tags = "" for tag in post_tags: escaped_tag = html.escape(tag, quote=True) safe_tags += f'{escaped_tag} ' # Trim trailing space and insert into template safe_tags = safe_tags.strip() return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( user_name=safe_user_name, post_heading=safe_heading, post_content=safe_content, post_tags=safe_tags )
